title: Gravitational quantum friction and the information-loss problem
summary: We study the gravitational collapse of a shell, modeled as a coherent state of quantum matter. Without adding any physics beyond semiclassical gravity, we show that the universal gravitational coupling between matter and geometry induces an interaction between the shell and the negative-frequency modes present in the $|in \rangle$ vacuum state. We find that this interaction occurs unavoidably immediately after a trapping horizon forms, making it a universal feature of semiclassical gravitational collapse.
